text: 你看见查理脸上的挣扎。“教授，您学识渊博。也许我不该相信长辈讲的小矮人传说。”她攥紧拳头。“我和您一样理性。”
查理继续履行职责，你们一行人继续前进。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 492
text: You see the conflict in Charlie’s face. “You speak with great learning, Professor. Perhaps I was foolish to believe the stories the elders tell of the Little Ones.” She clenches her fists. “I am rational, like you.”
Charlie resumes her duties and your party moves on.
